senses.gloss: m. (אור; cmp. רוּחַ a. רֶוַח); space corresp. to חָלָל, esp.
open, empty space, blank. Ohol. IV, 1 a tower שעומד בא׳ standing isolated. Ib. XVIII, 10 אוירָהּ של חצר the open space in the court-yard.—
(cmp. b. h. מְאוּרָה) hollow, cavity of a vessel.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:1">Kel. II, 1</cite> <he>מיתטמאין ומטמאין בא׳</he> become unclean and make unclean by contact with the hollow (of the vessel).—
<cite ref="Yevamot 67b:6">Yeb. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>נפק לא׳ העולם</he> came forth into the lighted space of the world, i.e. was born; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:12">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>הא׳ שממנו וכ׳</he> (as one of the elements of nature) out of which the wind was made.—
Gen. R. s. 34 א׳ יפה fine weather; a. fr.—Pl. אֲוִירִין blank spaces in writings.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34:11">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> <he>ברית נחלקה לא׳</he> a covenant has been made in favor of climates, i.e. God has implanted in man a love of his native soil even in bad climates.
